sources.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision: Hands-On Guide to DeepSeek's First Vision Model
sources.snippet: deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp is the first image-input model in the DeepSeek V4 family - an experimental release that hit 458 points on Hacker News on day one. This guide covers what it can do, the three ways to send images, OpenAI/Anthropic compatibility, token billing, and caveats, so you can decide fast whether to integrate it.
